method: Existing Blender region probes supply persistent edge IDs and adjacent-face angles. Propose candidates at an explicit 25 degree threshold, review surface behavior, and add localized intent overrides only when evidence warrants.

failure.observation: Dark marks at the housing shoulder persisted with shadows and cavity disabled.
failure.cause: Unconstrained coplanar shoulder connections allow the subdivision surface to intrude into the raised column footprint.

repair.action: Preserve four coplanar shoulder corner connections in addition to the angular feature candidates.

reproduction.environment: Set BLENDER_TEST_EXECUTABLE to a Blender executable and run pytest on that test.

general_lesson: Angle-based edge selection is a proposal, not complete surface intent. Coplanar constraints can matter at concave junctions. Inspect evaluated overlap as well as silhouette, manifoldness, and normals.

general_localization_followup.method: Blender BVH overlap candidates on non-adjacent evaluated triangles; no fixture dimensions used by the detector.
general_localization_followup.limits: Shared-vertex neighbors are excluded; adjacent foldovers and coplanar overlap may be missed. Candidates require inspection. Evaluated polygon indices are not persistent base-cage IDs.

limits: Only two controlled fixtures; not ordinary-reference reconstruction
The observer chose the repair. The later BVH detector localizes candidates automatically but does not choose construction changes.
Regression uses fixture-local coordinates to measure the known defect
No universal crease threshold or automatic professional-quality claim
